results.title: returns Maybe and IOResult railway composition with map and bind
results.summary: Railway-style composition over returns Maybe and IOResult: map versus bind, short-circuiting Nothing, maybe and bind_optional, impure_safe failures and IO-boxed unwrap, all tested offline.

results.title: FastAPI OAuth2 password flow with PyJWT tokens and scope checks
results.summary: OAuth2 password login issuing PyJWT access tokens, Argon2 hashes via pwdlib, and per-route scope checks with SecurityScopes, tested offline with TestClient.

results.title: RS256 JWTs with PyJWT and cryptography-generated keys
results.summary: Generate an RSA keypair with cryptography, sign RS256 JWTs with PyJWT, and verify them with a public key while enforcing algorithm, audience, expiry and signature checks, all tested offline.

results.title: FastAPI + PyJWT bearer auth
results.summary: OAuth2 password flow in FastAPI issuing PyJWT tokens, with a current-user dependency guarding routes.

results.title: pretty-bytes unit formatting
results.summary: Format byte counts with pretty-bytes using signed, bits, binary and minimumFractionDigits options, asserting 0, kB/MB/GB boundaries and negative values offline.

results.title: NetworkX DiGraph shortest paths, topological sort and cycle detection
results.summary: Build a directed dependency graph, topologically order it, detect cycles with find_cycle, and pick shortest routes while keeping weighted Dijkstra vs hop-count BFS straight.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 + Alembic programmatic migrations
results.summary: Alembic migrations driven from Python (upgrade, downgrade, autogenerate check) against SQLite, with SQLAlchemy 2 models.

results.title: pako deflate and gzip roundtrips
results.summary: Compress and decompress Uint8Array and string payloads with pako deflate/inflate and gzip/ungzip, checking roundtrip equality and using the level option.

results.title: PyArrow Table to Parquet bytes roundtrip with schema and compression
results.summary: Serialize a PyArrow Table to Parquet bytes in memory and read it back, checking schema, nulls, timezone, metadata and compression codec.

results.title: ArkType 2 schemas with morphs, narrows and discriminated unions
results.summary: Validate and transform data with ArkType 2: object schemas, morph pipes, narrow predicates, and discriminated unions returning typed data or readable problems.
